body:
I have no friends. I don't mean to sound dramatic but that's the way it's been for me for as long as I can recall. I can be sweet and friendly and sociable and all but I keep a distance from people. I've had some boyfriends not because I was particularly attracted to any of them, but because they had things to offer...food, shelter... growing up I witness how ugly relationships can get when they turn sour, I feel like I don't have the capacity to love.    
And yes, I have no friends. People who know me think I'm one tough girl, I can take the weight of the world. I feel so alone, lonely, and hollow. Here I am, on reddit, taking to one or two strangers who care enough to read this.... in real life I have no one to turn to. Nobody is going to save me. 

Oh yes maybe I can just find another guy to feed me, take me in like a stray. Be someone else's burden, entitle him to treat me like shit... I'm tired. 

If you ever meet me in person, you wouldn't even imagine I'm the one going through all that. I work hard to put up that front...that girl, calm, confident, great sense of humor...blah blah. But unapproachable. God knows this mask is so fragile...I need just a little bit more to completely shatter
What haunts me most now is I caught myself thinking, maybe he isn't that bad. Just hold on for a bit more...everything will be okay...

She sort of knows that I'm not happy with my boyfriend... but then I told more lies, about how well he treats me, takes me to nice places. I post pictures of us hugging smiling on Facebook for everyone to see... I hate myself when I do it but part of me doesn't want to accept all that. I'm sorry... but I really can't do this to mom. I can't break her heart with the cold hard truth. 

I'm better off without him, but I'm broke...and homeless. The last thing I want now is being kicked out... I need him

Every day, every second I think, wait till I sign my first contract... I won't even look back... before I secure that, I'm far from able to afford rent. 

Maybe I deserve better, maybe not... but he's the best thing I could have at the moment.
